workflows.name: Housekeeping - Close stale issues and PRs

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'stale' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'integration-test' step 2 uses unpinned action 'helm/kind-action@v1.12.0'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'integration-test' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set 'with: persist-credentials: false' on actions/checkout steps in jobs that upload artifacts.

anti_patterns.message: CRITICAL: Job 'lint' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
anti_patterns.remediation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

anti_patterns.message: Deployment workflow triggers on 'push' without branch or tag filters.
anti_patterns.remediation: Restrict push triggers using explicit 'branches:' or 'tags:' allowlists (for example, branches: [main]).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'release' step 3 interpolates untrusted event context or writes untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV/$GITHUB_PATH.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pass untrusted GitHub context values through intermediate step 'env:' variables, quote shell expansions, and avoid writing untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV or $GITHUB_PATH.
